decision_needed.question: Miscellaneous receipts of 2,578,990 are mostly the Health Insurance Fund (2,398,135) and Miscellaneous General disbursements of 3,210,559 are unitemized. Should these be recategorized (for example premium contributions as charges for services)? If the Health Insurance Fund receipts are premiums paid by other county funds, they would also be counted in those funds' disbursements (interfund double count); the trimmed pages do not say who pays them.

notes: Cash-basis county; governmental funds only (no business-type funds). Receipts/disbursements/transfers are the Total Governmental Funds column of the Statement of Cash Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Cash Basis Fund Balances (p4). Taxes of 11,009,457 are one line; only the Inheritance Fund column (762,817) can be separated, the rest is taxes (unlabeled). Transfers in/out net to zero (4,274,362 each). Detail: General Fund from the budget-and-actual schedule by department (p5, actual and final budget; function mapping verified against p4 General Fund column: general government 2,780,058, public safety 4,435,666, public works 151,637, public assistance 456,433, miscellaneous 3,214,759 incl. Abandoned Cemetery 4,200, capital 126,540). Major funds Road, Inheritance, Health Insurance, COVID ARPA and Special Road are recorded from their columns on p4 (their budget schedules on pp6-8 only give one disbursements total, so those budget schedules are not duplicated; budget_final from them where lines match). More than 6 nonmajor funds, so nonmajor detail uses the Total Nonmajor Funds column on p21; the per-fund budget schedules (pp9-14) and combining pages are not duplicated. Transfer cross-check: all transfers in (General 675,000, Road 1,841,079, Special Road 1,198,750, nonmajor 559,533) equal transfers out (General 2,366,112, Road 1,198,750, Inheritance 675,000, nonmajor 34,500); no hidden transfers in spending lines. Attempt 2 (targeted re-check): balance sheet now from the Statement of Cash Basis Assets and Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (p3), Total Governmental Funds column, fund balance by classification (restricted, committed, assigned, unassigned); its totals (19,342,275) equal the cash-basis Statement of Net Position (p1). No liabilities printed. Intergovernmental lines print no homestead/tax-credit/pro-rate breakdown, so they are not split. Printed report net change (1,657) ties to net position 19,343,932 to 19,342,275. Read pages 1-21 of 21
